resources.string: Unofficial Android port of the OpenBarnyard decompilation (TOSHI 2.0 engine)

1) Copy the PC game files into the GameData folder (see “Game data”).
2) Tune “Graphics & performance” or leave it on Auto.
3) Arrange the on-screen controls to your taste.
4) Press Play!
No game files are included with this app — you need your own legally owned copy of Barnyard (PC). Support THQ Nordic and the original TOSHI developers!

Engine status: the Android platform layer (launcher, GLES renderer, touch input, optimisation) is fully working and Play launches the interactive farm tech-demo scene wired to the real engine input commands. The TOSHI gameplay renderer (GL shaders for the original DX8 materials, FMOD/Bink replacements) is the remaining porting work — see Android/PORTING.md in the repository.

Copy the contents of your PC Barnyard installation (the folder containing Data/ and Barnyard.exe) into the folder below using USB or any file manager — or pick an existing folder with the button. No files are downloaded; nothing leaves your device.
The data is only inspected (file names/counts) for verification today; it will be read by the engine as the TOSHI GL renderer lands. Your files are never modified.
If something misbehaves, copy this report into a GitHub issue — it contains CPU/GPU and configuration details (no personal data).
Farm tech-demo · engine port in progress — controls are live, try the stick & buttons!

OpenBarnyard is an open-source decompilation of Barnyard (2006) and the TOSHI 2.0 engine by Blue Tongue Entertainment. This Android package adds, on top of that codebase:

• a full launcher with device auto-tuning
• an editable multi-touch control system bound to the engine's real AInputCommand ids
• a native GLES2/3 core with dynamic resolution, frame pacing and runtime SIMD dispatch, built for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a (32-bit), x86_64 and x86
• game-data management for your own PC copy

The remaining step for full gameplay is finishing TOSHI's GL renderer (the PC shaders are DirectX 8) and replacing FMOD/Bink — tracked in Android/PORTING.md. Engine © THQ Nordic / original authors; this project is for education and preservation. Do not use it to pirate the game.
